name: Draft Gmail support replies with an AI agent and send after approval
description: For each new email in Gmail, an AI agent reads the full thread and earlier emails from the same customer with the Gmail tools, decides whether it needs a reply, and drafts one. A person edits and approves the draft in an approval form, and only then is the reply sent in the original thread. Newsletters and automated emails are logged and skipped.
shortDescription: An AI agent drafts replies to support emails, and nothing is sent until a person approves.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with two Gmail tools, Get thread and Search email, for conversation context
Structured JSON response that flags emails that do not need a reply
Approval step after the agent, delivered to the Approval Tasks inbox, with the draft reply editable in the form
Reply sent in the original Gmail thread only after approval
prerequisites: Google Mail (Gmail) connection for the support inbox
Someone who answers requests in the Approval Tasks inbox, or swap the Approval Task channel for Slack, email or another channel
Server public URL configured, so the approval form link can be generated
idealFor: Small support teams that want AI-drafted replies to incoming email while keeping a person in charge of what is sent.
steps: Trigger: poll Gmail for a new email.
Draft a reply: the AI Agent reads the thread and the sender's earlier emails with its Gmail tools and returns a summary, a draft reply and whether a reply is needed.
Needs a reply: if not, log the summary and stop.
Approve reply: the run pauses and sends an approval request to the Approval Tasks inbox, with a form where the reviewer can edit the draft.
Approved: send the approved reply in the original thread. Rejected: log the rejection and the reviewer's note.
